ConnectionStrings._comment: Not used. The SQL connection string is composed at runtime by SqlConnectionFactory from the Database:* values, which arrive as Database__Host / Database__Name / Database__User / Database__Password environment variables injected from AWS Parameter Store and Secrets Manager. Never add a literal connection string here.

Graph._comment: Graph uses the shared Entra app registration. No separate Graph feature flag or duplicate secret is required; the API reads Entra__TenantId, Entra__ClientId and Entra__ClientSecret when these values are absent.

Entra._comment: Shared Entra ID secret source for both internal sign-in and Graph application credentials. Keep only one client secret in Secrets Manager and expose it via Entra__ClientSecret.
